text_block_list.text:
Dragged along by Sweep Tosho,
I was brought to the zoo.
When I asked if there was an animal she wanted to see...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm looking for the "Ultimate Familiar"!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Strong, smart, and fluffy to the touch!
I'm looking for the ultimate familiar that has it all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "They renovated this zoo, and the number of animals increased like crazy! It's the perfect place to search! Let's get going right away!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Waaah... it was so fluffy!
Alpaca, you might lack strength,
but your fur feels amazing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Alright, you're going to become my familiar!
And then use magic to knit fluffy towels and stuff!

text_block_list.name: Alpaca
text_block_list.text: Puuurrgh?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey! Why are you running away!?
Hold it right theeeere!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, that kangaroo!
It's so buff! Looks super strong, right?!

text_block_list.name: Kangaroo
text_block_list.text: Vo-! Veurgh-!!
choice_data_list: It feels like they're staring right at me...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"It's definitely claiming to be the strongest familiar...
It wants to show off its power!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Right?! As her senior familiar,
you should be her boxing partner! Come on, come on♪

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Sign-ups for the 'Owl Meet-and-Greet Show'
are now officially closed!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? I wanna join in!
I wanna have an owl deliver letters and stuff~~!
choice_data_list: S-Sorry! I'd like to join too!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Familiar! I can't hear you with a voice like that!
Dash while shouting your point even louder!!
Even after that, we toured the zoo together, despite me being led around by the nose by Sweep Tosho...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm so thirsty, and my legs are completely exhausted! This place is way too huge!
Even though there are still familiar candidates I haven't met yet—

"Attention, all park visitors.
Our park will be closing shortly."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Eeeh, the park's closing already?! Come on~~!

"Sweep Tosho voiced her exhaustion and discontent.
Given this pattern, the words to follow are surely—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
NO NO NOOO WAY--!!
I'm staying right here until I find my familiar!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"After searching around this much, you know!?
Going home just exhausted, NOOO WAAAY!!"
choice_data_list: (I've got to convince her to go home somehow...!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey, familiar!
choice_data_list: I-I get how you feel! That's why—
I-I know how you feel! That's why—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yeah! That was super fun, wasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Jeez, I can't believe a genius magical girl like me forgot to cast a time-extension spell!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's not fair how fast it went by!
I'll have to be more careful next time!
choice_data_list: I thought you'd be a lot angrier...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I got to meet so many prospective familiars, you know?
Just imagining what kind of magic I could teach them made me so excited!

"...I fully expected a tantrum,
but it seems Sweep Tosho
thoroughly enjoyed her day!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Scouting a candidate for the strongest familiar
will be my next delight! Fufu, I can hardly wait♪"
choice_data_list: What should we do about souvenirs?
Who are you gonna scout first?
Who are you going to scout first?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Scouting a candidate for the strongest familiar
will be my next delight! Fufu, I can hardly wait♪"
choice_data_list: What should we do about souvenirs?
Who are you gonna scout first?
Who are you going to scout first?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...!
Good catch!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I already know which plushie I want!
Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fuwawa the alpaca, and Fou the owl!
Listen up! Starting today, you two are apprentice familiars! You'd better be grateful!

On the train at dusk.
Watching her happily gaze at the plushie,
I felt inspired to make even more fun memories for her.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I can't decide yet!
Even when I talk to them, they won't look at me at all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Time to practice magical beast languages once we're home...
Familiar, you're studying with me too, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Lion language, kangaroo language,
owl language too... and I gotta chat with the alpaca, too!
Seeing her talk about everything she saw today with such a cheerful voice made me want to make more fun memories for her.
